about_the_game:
It’s time for the zombies to take revenge. Take control of the zombie hordes and use your unholy powers to put humanity in its place.

Gather DNA research and mutate your zombies, enhancing them with special abilities to help you in your pursuit of world domination.

Look out for humanities defences, they won’t go down easily.

Forge your route through the world map, deciding between high-risk rewards or safer paths.

Infect and tear through hand-crafted maps, each offering multiple approaches to victory.

Keep an eye out for difficult maps, mini-bosses, and horde modes, they may be too much for you at the beginning.

Wage war as the living throw all of their defences at you. Keep an eye out for tanks, mortar teams, and other powerful city defences that you may face.

As you progress, you will be able to access the shop and the research station. You will need to stockpile corpses and research points to use in these locations.

The shop will allow you to purchase new special zombies, destructive abilities, and powerful one time use totems to use against humanity.

The research station allows you to upgrade your zombies, improving their stats or unlocking unique abilities to help increase the power of your zombie horde.

It doesn’t end when you reach the end of the world map. Humanity will instead come back stronger than ever.

Once the world map is complete, humanity's resistance level will rise, causing maps to have more enemies, obstacles, and defences than ever before. 

Humanity will gain random unique modifiers at each resistance level that you will have to keep in mind as your progress.

Can you make it all the way to resistance 5?

Features:

  • Unlock 7 available zombie types, including the Rippers, the Bulkers, and the Screamers

  • Fight through 12 tailored maps and the unique challenges they bring

  • Find 16 blessings that change the way you play

  • Access 22 unique and powerful upgrades for each of your zombie types through the research station

  • Navigate through the world map, choosing your own path to domination

  • Battle against 16 city defences that humanity will use to try to stop you

  • Gather corpses from fallen humans and use them to buy new abilities, zombies, totems or powerful contracts from the shop.

  • Once you have completed the world map, increase the resistance level, each map will feature new challenges, defences, and modifiers for you to play against.

Early Access

Help build the future of Zombie God as we include community feedback in new updates. We love to hear the thoughts and feedback of the community as it helps us build a better game.

We are still working on this game, and it is still in Early Access. As such, there may be bugs and other issues, if you find any, let us know, and we will fix them!

content_descriptors.notes: Cartoon depictions of violence, blood & gore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i3 5th Gen
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU / Laptop APU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Core i5 5th Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: It’s time for the zombies to take revenge. Humanity has been happy for far too long, use your arsenal of unholy powers, mutated zombies, and destructive totems to put humanity back in its place in this strategy roguelike game.
